title: Tributes in Honour of Maria Lis Lange: Scholar, Administrator, Activist, Leader
summary: Through a critical engagement and treatment of the ideas, approaches, commitments and questions that defined Lis Lange’s work, this Festschrift brings together colleagues, collaborators, friends and fellow thinkers in a collection that offers a rich portrait of one of South African higher education’s most influential and uncompromising scholar-administrators.This book is a valuable resource for those interested in intellectually driven governance and leadership as forms of critical praxis and strategic institution-building.
